policy: Every Rust workspace package has one hard maximum of 20,000 scc Code/CLOC under the checked checkout census. Every checked-in Rust file assigned to a package counts in full, including standalone tests, examples, benches, inline tests, test support, unreachable code, and every cfg/feature/path variant. Only immutable admission offenders may have active temporary ceilings. Each accepted successor ceiling must equal current CLOC and may never exceed the previous accepted mainline ceiling; retired exceptions become permanent tombstones and can never be resurrected. New exceptions, manual exclusions, ceiling increases, and advisory tiers are forbidden.
